messages:
alex: FYI — upstream advisories just dropped for kubelet (CVE-2026-1450), etcd (CVE-2026-2101), cert-manager (CVE-2026-3003). Need quick triage and patch window planning.

priya: Do we have CVSS + exploitability notes? Any public PoC?

alex: Summary: etcd CVE-2026-2101 RCE via unauthenticated gRPC path (CVSS 9.8), vendor says patch available. kubelet CVE-2026-1450 local privilege escalation (CVSS 7.5), requires kubelet binary update. cert-manager CVE-2026-3003 is a webhook privilege escalation (CVSS 8.2), patch available in v1.16.2.

sam: Priority: etcd P0 — cluster compromise. Kubelet P1 (needs node drain sequence), cert-manager P1 but can do canary first.

margo: For cert-manager upgrade we might need RBAC changes: new ClusterRole `cert-manager-controller` adds `get` on secrets in some namespaces. I'll open an afford change set.

leo: Audit logging ask: enable webhook/audit policy to log `create` on Secrets & Token requests in staging and prod for 48h post-patch. We should also collect etcd access logs.

jen: KMS note: rotating the envelope keys before/after etcd restore window. If etcd backup/restore uses S3 + KMS, we must validate decryption with rotated key in staging.

infra-bot: inventory: affected clusters: prod-a (etcd v3.5.8), prod-b (etcd v3.5.7), staging (etcd v3.5.8), canary (etcd v3.5.8)

priya: Plan proposal: 1) create canary in canary cluster for etcd patched binary + cert-manager release, run e2e for 2h. 2) schedule non-peak patch window for prod-a (etcd first), 3) rolling kubelet update with drain+uncordon.

sam: For etcd patch we need snapshot backup + test restore to dev cluster. Add playbook step:
```
ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot save /tmp/snap.db --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 --cacert=... --cert=... --key=...
etcdctl snapshot status /tmp/snap.db
```

margo: RBAC PR: I'll target `release/certmgr-1.16.2` branch, include ClusterRole changes + helm value `extraClusterRoles` override. Will request review from sec.

leo: Audit policy snippet for 48h:
```
apiVersion: audit.k8s.io/v1
kind: Policy
rules:
- level: Request
  verbs: ["create", "update"]
  resources:
  - group: ""
    resources: ["secrets"]
  - group: "authentication.k8s.io"
    resources: ["tokenreviews"]
```

jen: KMS checklist:
- rotate envelope key in staging
- validate etcd snapshot decryption
- rotate in prod after successful patch

alex: Rollback plan: if etcd incidents during upgrade, restore snapshot to standby cluster and failover. For kubelet regressions, use daemonset to pin old binary and drain/uncordon.

priya: Owners: etcd patch -> sam, cert-manager & RBAC -> margo, kubelet rolling -> alex + infra; audit & KMS validation -> leo + jen.

sam: I'll schedule canary for 0900 PT tomorrow and run backup+e2e. cc @margo @jen

margo: I'll open RBAC PR + link helm overrides. ETA EOD.

jen: I'll prepare KMS rotate playbook and test keys in staging before 0900.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster reservation created for 2026-06-12T09:00Z -> 2026-06-12T12:00Z

priya: Great. Post mortem checklist: keep audit logs, token request traces, and resource diffs. We'll reconvene after canary.

alex: Thanks all :thumbsup: Keep thread updated if any blocker surfaces.
